item.text:
Implemented the admin catalog page and cache flow.

- [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:10) renders the catalog and uses a regular HTML form with an inline Server Action. Submitting it calls `revalidateTag('products', 'max')`, so the cached list can remain available while Next refreshes it in the background.
- [lib/products.ts](/workspace/lib/products.ts:7) caches the product query under the shared `"products"` tag for catalog views to reuse.
- [app/globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:1) and [app/layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:1) add the responsive admin layout and page metadata.

The repository’s `getAllProducts()` is currently a simulated data source, with no ERP/PIM connector or import job configured. The action invalidates the shared cached read; connecting an actual upstream import would require wiring that source into the existing data layer. I haven’t run tests or a build.
